a: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) shows I/O during query execution.
Seq scans read whole tables; fine for small tables, costly for large.
Index-only scans avoid heap fetches when visibility allows.
Autovacuum keeps tables healthy; monitor bloat.
Partitioning splits large tables for manageability and performance.
FDWs query external data sources from SQL.
RLS restricts which rows a user can access.
Generated columns compute values from other columns.
LATERAL allows subqueries to reference preceding FROM items.
MERGE performs insert/update/delete based on match conditions.
